==Notes==
This event is called "LANIUS_TRADER_TRANSLATOR" in the datafiles. 
* This event offers similar trades to the [[Lanius trader]] event but has an option to get a Lanius named Translator, as suggested by the distinctive intro text, however, the blue option to get a better trade offer is not available in this event.
